frase.texto: Fifty million ‘Hail Marys’ rising to Heaven from every part of the world and in every language, asking for peace, joining together like one enormous Rosary, embracing all the continents, peoples, and nations of the world.
frase.fuente: Mensaje a los niños en el Rosario en los Jardines Vaticanos

fuente.titulo: A rosary in the Vatican for ‘peace for all the children in the world' - Vatican News

bajada: Mensaje a los niños en el Rosario en los Jardines Vaticanos · 2026
caption:
“Fifty million ‘Hail Marys’ rising to Heaven from every part of the world and in every language, asking for peace, joining together like one enormous Rosary, embracing all the continents, peoples, and nations of the world.”

— Pope Leo XIV, Mensaje a los niños en el Rosario en los Jardines Vaticanos (2026)

Via Vatican News, 1 October 2026

#PopeLeoXIV #Vatican #CatholicChurch
